It was released on April 12, 2026 on HBO and HBO Max. Contents 1 Premise 2 Plot 3 Plot 4 Credits 4.1 Cast 4.2 Crew 5 Trivia 6 Soundtrack 7 Gallery 8 References Premise[] What's Rue been up to since high school? Honestly, nothing good. Plot[] Rue acts as a drug mule for Laurie to pay debts, Nate runs his father's business, and Cassie pursues internet fame to fund a wedding. Plot[] Credits[] Cast[] Starring Zendaya as Rue Bennett Jacob Elordi as Nate Jacobs Sydney Sweeney as Cassie Howard Alexa Demie as Maddy Perez Maude Apatow as Lexi Howard Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje as Alamo Brown Martha Kelly as Laurie Chloe Cherry as Faye Valentine Toby Wallace as Wayne Guest Starring Sharon Stone as Patricia Lance Colleen Camp as LA Nights Director Marshawn "Beast Mode" Lynch as G Darrell Britt-Gibson as Bishop James Landry Hébert as Harley Rebecca Pidgeon as Ms. Penzler Gideon Adlon as Gillie Colman Domingo as Ali Muhammad Asante Blackk as Kidd Homer Gere as Dylan Reid Jessica Blair Herman as Heather Madison Thompson as Oceana Co-Starring Adele Abinante as Abigail Miller Dwayne Tarver as Mr. Miller Jodi Moore Lewis as Mrs. Miller Jessica Treska as Daisy Miller Daeg Faerch as Mitch Melvin "Bonez" Estes as Bruce Sr. Mario Ponce as Uno Chester Milton as Smokeshop Customer Kat Johnston as Strung Out Girl William Guirola as Mexican Soldier Pete Pano as Medical Examiner Frank Krueger as CBP Officer Minerva Garcia as Juana David Haley as Foreman Marsha Gambles as Miss Marsha Jacy King as First AD Christopher J.
